decision: HOLD: only two runtime functions change by 80 static instructions; no demonstrated real-workload speedup. Full native compiler execution and final whole-workspace gate are not claimed for this late source.

baselineImplementation.proof: The two original optimizer source modules exactly match current local main. All other current-main host packages and the candidate source catalog are shared.

manifest.scope: Current-main matched generated-code comparison with bounded field forwarding and cleanup; exact identical compiler source input for both native representations.

control.scope: Two manifest-covered original optimizer modules, independently compared against direct baseline107 full compiler bytes before native entry.

controlIdentity.scope: Same frozen source, sealed hash-covered baseline inliner reproduces the catalog-repaired baseline94 full compiler image byte for byte. No new native process.

prepared.scope: Node stage1 preparation only; all Node optimization tracing is manifest-covered and the independent baseline must match the sealed control byte for byte. Native execution is intentionally gated on static inspection.

raw.scope: Bespoke same-source operation benchmark; not Test262 coverage. proc_pid_rusage V4 instruction/cycle and user/system CPU counters converted through mach_timebase_info, sampled every 1 ms between initial stop and final exit. CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.
